title: Economic and event calendar in Asia Thursday, September 3, 2026 - another China PMI
description: The data release of note due today, Thursday, September 3, 2026, from the Asian timezone is the private sector services PMI survey from Rating Dog / S&P. Look back recap: this week's China PMI data Monday brought the official NBS releases for August. The Manufacturing PMI rose to 49.8, up from 49.2 in July and slightly ahead of the 49.7 consensus. It marked a second straight month in contraction territory (sub-50), but the underlying detail was constructive: output and new orders both flipped back into expansion, and new export orders followed suit.
